verdict.rationale: GoDaddy's docs let you read/export DNS records via API and toggle the registry transfer-lock to enable moving a domain elsewhere (godaddy-docs-4, godaddy-docs-6, godaddy-docs-21), which is the closest thing to 'exporting data and leaving' for a registrar. However, independent community reports describe GoDaddy actively blocking whois requests needed for transfers out, slowing the process (godaddy-comm-11), directly contradicting a smooth 'leave with your data' experience; other community posts confirm people had to fight friction to migrate domains away (godaddy-comm-9, godaddy-comm-10). Missing for 10: no dedicated bulk data-export tool, no explicit open-format export of account/DNS/WHOIS history, and independent evidence of transfer obstruction undercuts the 'leave freely' claim.
